measure: a ratio or percentage with a carefully scoped denominator
gold_sql:
WITH filtered_measurements AS (
  SELECT
    apm.measurement_id,
    apm.allele_id,
    apm.peptide_id,
    apm.measurement_value,
    apm.reliability_score,
    a.class AS allele_class,
    p.length AS peptide_length,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY apm.allele_id
      ORDER BY apm.measurement_value DESC
    ) AS value_rank
  FROM allele_peptide_measurements AS apm
  JOIN alleles AS a
    ON apm.allele_id = a.allele_id
  JOIN peptides AS p
    ON apm.peptide_id = p.peptide_id
  WHERE apm.measurement_value IS NOT NULL
    AND apm.reliability_score IS NOT NULL
    AND p.length > 8
    AND a.class IS NOT NULL
),
top_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    allele_id,
    allele_class,
    measurement_value,
    reliability_score
  FROM filtered_measurements
  WHERE value_rank = 1
),
class_totals AS (
  SELECT
    allele_class,
    COUNT(*) AS top_measurement_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN reliability_score >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_reliability_count
  FROM top_ranked
  GROUP BY allele_class
)
SELECT
  allele_class,
  top_measurement_count,
  high_reliability_count,
  ROUND(1.0 * high_reliability_count / top_measurement_count, 4) AS high_reliability_ratio
FROM class_totals
ORDER BY high_reliability_ratio DESC, top_measurement_count DESC

measure: a label assigned by thresholds on a computed quantity
gold_sql:
WITH entity_access AS (
  SELECT
    d.output_id,
    d.output_name,
    COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count
  FROM digital_outputs AS d
  JOIN access_logs AS al
    ON al.output_id = d.output_id
  LEFT JOIN output_metadata AS om
    ON om.output_id = d.output_id
   AND om.is_active = 1
  GROUP BY d.output_id, d.output_name
),
labeled_entities AS (
  SELECT
    output_id,
    output_name,
    access_count,
    CASE
      WHEN access_count >= 500 THEN 'high_access'
      WHEN access_count >= 100 THEN 'medium_access'
      ELSE 'low_access'
    END AS access_label
  FROM entity_access
)
SELECT
  access_label AS access_label,
  COUNT(*) AS output_count,
  AVG(access_count) AS avg_access_count,
  MAX(access_count) AS max_access_count
FROM labeled_entities
WHERE access_count > 0
GROUP BY access_label
ORDER BY avg_access_count DESC
LIMIT 1

measure: a share of a total, computed against a window or subtotal
gold_sql:
WITH article_access AS (
  SELECT
    a.article_id,
    a.title,
    COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN al.access_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS access_coverage_ratio,
    MAX(al.access_date) AS latest_access_date
  FROM articles a
  LEFT JOIN access_logs al
    ON al.article_id = a.article_id
  GROUP BY a.article_id, a.title
),
review_stats AS (
  SELECT
    article_id,
    COUNT(review_id) AS review_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS review_status_ratio,
    MAX(review_date) AS latest_review_date
  FROM article_reviews
  GROUP BY article_id
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(access_count) AS total_accesses
  FROM article_access
)
SELECT
  aa.article_id,
  aa.title AS article_title,
  aa.access_count,
  ROUND(1.0 * aa.access_count / NULLIF(t.total_accesses, 0), 4) AS access_share_of_total,
  aa.access_coverage_ratio,
  rs.review_count,
  rs.review_status_ratio,
  aa.latest_access_date,
  rs.latest_review_date
FROM article_access aa
LEFT JOIN review_stats rs
  ON rs.article_id = aa.article_id
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY access_share_of_total DESC, aa.access_count DESC, aa.article_id

measure: a per-unit rate (per day, per member, per km)
naive_sql:
SELECT
  a.author_id AS author_id,
  a.first_name AS first_name,
  a.last_name AS last_name,
  ROUND(CAST(COUNT(r.review_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(p.paper_id), 2) AS reviews_per_paper
FROM authors AS a
JOIN papers AS p
  ON p.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN reviews AS r
  ON r.paper_id = p.paper_id
GROUP BY a.author_id, a.first_name, a.last_name
ORDER BY reviews_per_paper DESC, author_id
gold_sql:
WITH paper_counts AS (
  SELECT
    a.author_id,
    a.first_name,
    a.last_name,
    COUNT(p.paper_id) AS paper_count
  FROM authors AS a
  LEFT JOIN papers AS p
    ON p.author_id = a.author_id
  GROUP BY a.author_id, a.first_name, a.last_name
),
review_counts AS (
  SELECT
    a.author_id,
    COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count
  FROM authors AS a
  LEFT JOIN papers AS p
    ON p.author_id = a.author_id
  LEFT JOIN reviews AS r
    ON r.paper_id = p.paper_id
  GROUP BY a.author_id
)
SELECT
  pc.author_id AS author_id,
  pc.first_name AS first_name,
  pc.last_name AS last_name,
  ROUND(CAST(rc.review_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(pc.paper_count, 0), 2) AS reviews_per_paper
FROM paper_counts AS pc
JOIN review_counts AS rc
  ON rc.author_id = pc.author_id
ORDER BY reviews_per_paper DESC, author_id

measure: a count of events per entity
gold_sql:
WITH publication_counts AS (
  SELECT
    project_id,
    COUNT(*) AS publication_count
  FROM publications
  WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY project_id
),
presentation_counts AS (
  SELECT
    project_id,
    COUNT(*) AS presentation_count
  FROM presentations
  WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY project_id
)
SELECT
  fp.project_id AS project_id,
  fp.application_id AS application_id,
  COALESCE(pc.publication_count, 0) AS publication_count,
  COALESCE(prc.presentation_count, 0) AS presentation_count,
  COALESCE(pc.publication_count, 0) + COALESCE(prc.presentation_count, 0) AS total_event_count
FROM funded_projects AS fp
LEFT JOIN publication_counts AS pc
  ON fp.project_id = pc.project_id
LEFT JOIN presentation_counts AS prc
  ON fp.project_id = prc.project_id
ORDER BY total_event_count DESC, fp.project_id

measure: a per-unit rate (per day, per member, per km)
gold_sql:
WITH country_population AS (
  SELECT
    native_country_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_individuals,
    SUM(CASE WHEN veteran_status = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS veteran_individuals
  FROM individuals
  GROUP BY native_country_id
),
country_access AS (
  SELECT
    i.native_country_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_access_events,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ua.access_type = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_access_events
  FROM individuals i
  JOIN user_access ua
    ON ua.individual_id = i.individual_id
  GROUP BY i.native_country_id
)
SELECT
  c.country_name AS country_name,
  cp.veteran_individuals AS veteran_individuals,
  cp.total_individuals AS total_individuals,
  ROUND((cp.veteran_individuals * 1.0) / NULLIF(cp.total_individuals - ca.view_access_events, 0), 4) AS veterans_per_nonview_access_event
FROM country_population cp
JOIN country_access ca
  ON ca.native_country_id = cp.native_country_id
JOIN countries c
  ON c.country_id = cp.native_country_id
ORDER BY veterans_per_nonview_access_event DESC
